# Generated by tools/build_zhx_academy_lifecycle.py. Do not hand-edit.
# Active academy truth is the unique permanent province modifier.

zhx_academy_is_active_province = {
    OR = {
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_chongli
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_minglun
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_yifa
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_xunming
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_jianai
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_shangtong
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_xuantong
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_baopu
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_miaosuan
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_zhisheng
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_baihe
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_lianheng
    }
}

zhx_academy_is_former_site = {
    OR = {
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_ruins_chongli
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_ruins_minglun
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_ruins_yifa
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_ruins_xunming
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_ruins_jianai
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_ruins_shangtong
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_ruins_xuantong
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_ruins_baopu
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_ruins_miaosuan
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_ruins_zhisheng
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_ruins_baihe
        has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_ruins_lianheng
    }
}

zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = {
    is_city = yes
    NOT = { zhx_academy_is_active_province = yes }
    NOT = { zhx_academy_is_former_site = yes }
    NOT = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_under_expulsion }
}

zhx_academy_has_empty_host_province = {
    any_owned_province = { zhx_academy_is_empty_host_province = yes }
}

zhx_academy_has_unprotected_chongli = {
    any_owned_province = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_chongli }
    NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_ru }
    NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_ru_invited_scholar_modifier }
}

zhx_academy_is_unprotected_active_province = {
    OR = {
        AND = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_chongli owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_ru } NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_ru_invited_scholar_modifier } } }
        AND = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_minglun owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_ru } NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_ru_invited_scholar_modifier } } }
        AND = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_yifa owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_fa } NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_fa_invited_scholar_modifier } } }
        AND = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_xunming owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_fa } NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_fa_invited_scholar_modifier } } }
        AND = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_jianai owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_mo } NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_mo_invited_scholar_modifier } } }
        AND = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_shangtong owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_mo } NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_mo_invited_scholar_modifier } } }
        AND = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_xuantong owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_dao } NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_dao_invited_scholar_modifier } } }
        AND = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_baopu owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_dao } NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_dao_invited_scholar_modifier } } }
        AND = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_miaosuan owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_bing } NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_bing_invited_scholar_modifier } } }
        AND = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_zhisheng owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_bing } NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_bing_invited_scholar_modifier } } }
        AND = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_baihe owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_zongheng } NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_zongheng_invited_scholar_modifier } } }
        AND = { has_province_modifier = zhx_academy_lianheng owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_doctrine_zongheng } NOT = { has_country_modifier = zhx_zongheng_invited_scholar_modifier } } }
    }
}

zhx_academy_has_any_unprotected = {
    any_owned_province = { zhx_academy_is_unprotected_active_province = yes }
}

zhx_academy_has_two_unprotected_school_types = {
    OR = {
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_ru_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_fa_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_ru_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_mo_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_ru_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_dao_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_ru_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_bing_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_ru_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_zongheng_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_fa_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_mo_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_fa_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_dao_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_fa_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_bing_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_fa_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_zongheng_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_mo_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_dao_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_mo_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_bing_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_mo_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_zongheng_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_dao_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_bing_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_dao_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_zongheng_academy = yes }
        AND = { zhx_has_unprotected_bing_academy = yes zhx_has_unprotected_zongheng_academy = yes }
    }
}
